# HYROX Prague – HYROX coach, training and race prep in Prague and online

> HYROX training and race preparation in Prague, Czech Republic, with coach Ladislav Suchánek (HYROX Performance Coach) and Ria Suchánek Hrušovská. For athletes visiting Prague and for anyone racing HYROX abroad: 1:1 sessions in English at Form Factory Na Knížecí (Prague 5), HYROX Training Club classes at Form Factory in Prague, Brno and Ostrava, and online STR2G programs in English.

## Main pages
- [HYROX Prague (English)](https://hyrox-prague.eu/), [Čeština](https://hyrox-prague.eu/cs/), [Polski](https://hyrox-prague.eu/pl/), [Deutsch](https://hyrox-prague.eu/de/)
